KeysToEntries.ID_COMMUNITYEVENT_END_OF_COMMUNITY_SUBTI: The engineering crews are finishing up the necessary Raider structures around the Stella Montis facility.
The engineering crews are building Raider hatches to allow for a quick getaway.
The engineering crews are testing the radio systems to ensure Raiders can be warned of imminent danger.

KeysToEntries.ID_COMMUNITYEVENT_WINTER_POPUP_START_DES: As fierce snowfalls cover Topside in a frigid blanket, the inhabitants of Speranza gather together to salvage whatever warmth and community they can. The candleberry bush forms the centerpiece of these festivities, with Speranzans fashioning the hardy plant into a surprisingly lavish banquet.

During the event, the Cold Snap map condition will allow you to gather rare Candleberries, which can be used to prepare your own Candleberry Banquet. However, the risk of frostbite means going topside is even more dangerous than usual.
KeysToEntries.ID_COMMUNITYEVENT_WINTER_POPUP_END_DESCR: Though the sense of warmth and community may linger a while longer, the snows have started to thaw, and the last candleberry bushes have been plucked bare.
KeysToEntries.ID_COMMUNITYEVENT_WINTER_DESCRIPTION: Earn Merits by gathering rare Candleberries during the Cold Snap map condition, and use them to prepare your own Candleberry Banquet.
